name: Kuonji Rin
source:
A gun wielding miko from the City that is divided by the line, that also happens to rain steel tubs for some unknown, unexplained reason. Rin has a family corporation that deals with technology. She is serious, but has a fear of cockroaches. Rin is somewhat trigger-happy, so don’t you dare to scare her.

[Summarized from [url=http://algester.wordpress.com/2011/02/14/in-sadness-and-health-and-in-roneriness-we-fall-for-the-harems-to-call-and-we-know/]Algester's blog[/url].]
